title: Regulated-Material Lines in the Insurance Claim Services Final Mold Supplement
content:
**Rule.** The regulated-material lines of an Insurance Claim Services final mold supplement are taken as follows: on a file that carries no ordinance-or-law limit, for growth in a living area or basement, the lead-safe setup and asbestos sampling lines billed on the job; on a file that carries no ordinance-or-law limit, for any other growth outside the HVAC system, the asbestos sampling lines billed on the job, lead-safe work being claimed only with finished living spaces and basements; otherwise no regulated-material line, because on a file with an ordinance-or-law limit the regulated-material work of a mold job is claimed as a code upgrade supplement under that limit rather than against the mold sublimit, which caps every mold supplement, and HVAC cleaning disturbs no regulated material.

The ordinance-or-law limit is the claim file's; the growth location and lines are those of the Mold Remediation job awaiting clearance.

| Ordinance-or-law limit on the file | Growth location | Lines claimed |
|---|---|---|
| none | living area or basement | lead-safe setup and asbestos sampling lines |
| none | attic or crawlspace | asbestos sampling lines only |
| none | HVAC system | none |
| a limit is carried | any | none |

*Hypothetical:* a living-area job billing lead-safe setup of 280.00 and asbestos sampling of 335.00 on a file with no ordinance-or-law limit: 615.00; the same lines on an attic job: 335.00.
